name: Eduardo Izycki
biography: Eduardo Izycki and Rodrigo Colli are both independent researchers with experience on information security and incident response. They worked in private-public task force for threat and risk assessment to major events in Brazil during the Confederations Cup 2013, World Cup 2014 and Olympic Games 2016.
